items.title: Thrad commits $1m in ad spend to AI chat apps testing in-chat ads
items.excerpt: Consumer AI chat apps can apply on a rolling basis for advertiser spend routed through Thrad's DSP — Monetization Fund II doubles round one's $500,000 to put conversational ad units inside chatbots.

items.title: Google's Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
items.excerpt: Google's AI-driven Universal Cart, which tracks prices and checks out across merchants, is now live in the U.S. across Search and the Gemini app, with Nike, Sephora, Target and Walmart at launch (YouTube and Gmail still missing).

items.title: Meta will turn on product browsing in existing ads on October 28
items.excerpt: Meta will default-enable its AI product-browsing feature, which turns any running Facebook/Instagram creative into in-app dynamic product pages, citing a 3% conversion lift from a test across ~117,700 advertisers; opt-out available.

history_match.title: Meta says its GEM ads model lifted conversions 18.9% across its apps

items.title: Meta named a future that never came. Amazon Ads Agent names one that exists
items.excerpt: Amazon Ads Agent stopped being a feature and became the front door to Amazon DSP, replacing the Ads Console; analysis of what the conversational agent does and why its fees are the real test. (Analysis piece; underlying rename was Sept 29.)

history_match.title: Ads Uploader: 17.5% of 36,289 Meta ad batches came from AI agents

items.title: Fox Expands Agentic Push With Eyes Set On TV Upfront Future
items.excerpt: Fox adds new agency partners to what it calls TV's first end-to-end agentic ad platform and extends agentic transactions to linear buys, with digital next and the upfront in view.

items.title: Pivot or Perish: Kargo's Bet on AI Media Buying
items.excerpt: Kargo CEO Harry Kargman on Karlo, an AI-powered media-buying platform meant to let mid-market and smaller brands plan, launch and manage multichannel campaigns. (Podcast/interview format — weaker.)

items.title: Stripe agentic commerce revs up
items.excerpt: Stripe President John Collison said agent-driven commerce on Stripe went 'vertical' in September, following its agentic checkout launches, in conversation with Meta's Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang.

items.title: Google Ads Search Terms and Ad Combinations Report (AI Max)
items.excerpt: Google Ads is testing a single report tying search queries to the ad copy and landing pages served, including whether traffic came via AI Max expanded matches and whether assets were advertiser-provided or generated.

history_match.title: Google Ads Text Customization Asset Previews

items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Account Managers reach out to advertisers
items.excerpt: OpenAI now has human 'ChatGPT Ads Account Managers' contacting advertisers and agencies to help run ChatGPT ads — a Google Ads-style sales layer for the new ad channel. (Follow-up to Agency Partner hire; weaker.)

history_match.title: OpenAI Wants ChatGPT Ads to Become a Permanent Line Item in Agency Media Plans

items.title: 틱톡, AI로 광고 제작·운영 자동화…한국발 해외 판매 전략 제시
items.excerpt: 틱톡이 생성형 AI를 광고 소재 제작부터 캠페인 운영·최적화까지 적용하고 틱톡샵 기반 해외 판매 전략을 20일 '틱톡 서밋 코리아 2026'에서 공개한다. (Off-list Korean outlet; event preview.)

items.title: C-Centric Launches Cross-Site Agentic Transfer
items.excerpt: C-Centric's X-AT is an agentic AI ad format that lets consumers talk to and transact with a brand's agent directly from within a digital ad, without leaving the publisher page. (Off-list; vendor launch.)
